Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of BAC.
We generated $17.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 133 basis points to 37.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Revenue guidance of $24.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1523 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
